name: cosmos-methodology-tools
description: Turn conversations into durable, user-confirmed methodologies and continuously improve them.

interface.shortDescription: Build and maintain reusable methodologies from conversations.
interface.longDescription: Packages an explicit-only methodology assistant that inventories the shared Cosmos workspace's Markdown methodology library, lets the user choose whether to incrementally improve an existing methodology or create a new one, drafts changes from the current conversation, and writes only the final user-confirmed revision. The library is the fixed `~/Documents/cosmos-workspace/methodologies` and remains outside the replaceable plugin package.
defaultPrompt: Use $methodology-assistant to create or update a methodology from this conversation.
